const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:".venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python -m py_compile circopt && .venv/bin/python circopt check testdata/lowercase-x.circ --json && .venv/bin/python circopt --json check testdata/nested.circ && set +e
out=$(.venv/bin/python circopt --json --help); rc=$?
printf '%s\nHELP_STATUS %s\n' "$out" "$rc"
out=$(.venv/bin/python circopt -h --json); rc=$?
printf '%s\nSHORT_HELP_STATUS %s\n' "$out" "$rc"
out=$(.venv/bin/python circopt check --json); rc=$?
printf '%s\nMISSING_ARG_STATUS %s\n' "$out" "$rc"
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess
cases = [
    ([], 1, 'CliUsageError'),
    (['--json'], 1, 'CliUsageError'),
    (['check', 'testdata/parse.circ', '--json'], 2, 'CircParseError'),
    (['check', 'testdata/cycle.circ', '--json'], 3, 'CycleError'),
]
for args, code, kind in cases:
    p = subprocess.run(['.venv/bin/python', 'circopt', *args], text=True, capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == code, (args, p.returncode)
    if '--json' in args:
        body = json.loads(p.stdout)
        assert body['error']['type'] == kind
        assert not p.stderr
print('b
